new: Confidentiality and data privacy are strictly maintained throughout the study, in accordance with the Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173). Personal information and collected data, including performance records and adherence reports, are stored only on the computer at the research site and are used solely for research purposes. Participant names are recorded only with consent and are shown only on the therapist's dashboard. Each patient is identified by a patient code (for example, P-001) in all exports, reports and the VR application, and backups of the data are encrypted.

new: The process begins when the user starts the system. The physical therapist signs in to the therapist dashboard with a password, and the system validates these credentials before granting access. The patient does not sign in with a password: the VR application loads the program assigned by the therapist using the patient code, on the same computer. These two entry points separate the system into two major workflows, one for the Patient and one for the Physical Therapist.
